resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because fingerprint or iris matched a different parent Aadhaar only in part, with no face match of any kind against that parent.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is de-duplicated like a fresh enrolment and must not match another identity. Partial fingerprint or iris matches to a different parent, unsupported by any face match, left the comparison unresolved and the packet was rejected. A new packet with a careful, complete biometric capture is needed to settle those partial matches.
